## About
Cloud-Hidden Plants is a little plant shop at 703 Columbus Ave. We keep a changing mix of unusual house plants, cacti, succulent bonsai, caudex and stone plants, with new and rarer finds coming in through the seasons.
Anthony, the owner, pots the plants himself with soil and rock mixes chosen for each one. Stop by to see what's new, get some help with sun and soil, or show him how your plants are doing at home.
Along with the plants, you'll find modern and vintage pottery, ceramics from local artists, and a few things like palo santo, sage and candles. Rated 4.9 from 39 Google reviews.

## Services
- Unusual House Plants: A curated, always changing selection with an emphasis on rare plants, from affordable picks to high end specimens.
- Succulent Bonsai & Caudex: Succulents and cacti, including caudexes and stone plants, potted in mixes suited to each plant.
- Pottery: Modern small and medium sized pottery, including pots with stands and hanging pots, at prices one reviewer called really reasonable.

## FAQ
Q: Can you find a plant I'm looking for?
A: Often, yes. Tell Anthony what you're after and he'll try to track it down for you.

Q: Can I get help with plant care?
A: Yes. Ask in the shop and we'll walk you through the sun and soil your plant needs.

Q: When are you open?
A: Wednesday through Sunday, 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM. We're closed Monday and Tuesday.
